informal_statement:
There is a three-arc assembly of curvature \(r\) whose carrier equals \(E_r\). It has the stated regularity and
\[
A_\lambda(E_r)=A_3(r),
\]

\[
P_\lambda(E_r)=P_3(r).
\]
Its exterior half-angle
\[
\alpha=\arccos((2r-1)/\lambda)
\]
lies in \((0,\pi)\), and exceeds
\[
\pi/2
\]
if \(r<1/2\). The chord points \((x,1)\) with
\[
|x|<\sin\alpha/r
\]
are interior. Its bottom frontier is exactly
\[
\{(x,-1):|x|\leq D(2r-1)/r\}.
\]
If \(r=1/2\), then
\[
E_r=\{(x,y):x^2+(y-1)^2\leq4\}.
\]
